selection_rule.observation: Only archived values, comparisons and indexing; no model or matrix evaluation
selection_rule.coverage: recorded complete lap between first and second crossings; 0.3 s edge exclusion
selection_rule.curvature: packet.curvatures ZOH at archived control request time; this is exogenous nominal track curvature, not kappa_ref or actual plant curvature

straight.rule: all three samples t-0.1,t,t+0.1 satisfy bound

corner.rule: all three same-sign and above min

entry_exit.rule: absolute difference in end and start curvature

selection_rule.eligibility: native state exactly matches archived control sample; trajectory authority available and valid; no boundary violation; positive reserve; finite recorded values; source run stop_gate empty
selection_rule.allocation: For each category sort by time, pick remaining candidate nearest to rank targets 1/6, 1/2, 5/6 in its initial eligible list; ties earlier time; exclude any already selected point within 0.5 m s_abs. Insufficient coverage stays null; no replacement run or threshold relaxation.
selection_rule.domain_status: Archived run validity only; loads, true curvature, strict interior and derivative stencil checks remain NOT EXECUTED

selection_character: Static archived scalar extraction, indexing and predeclared comparisons; no geometry/model/Jacobian/eigenvalue evaluation
source_scope_limit: One controlled synthetic A lap; no independent track/vehicle coverage; high-speed/geometry membership overlaps but selected anchors differ
